nodes.name: RSS Read
nodes.notes: Reads each feed. Feed list comes from the Config node.

nodes.name: Feed catalogue
nodes.notes: Emits one item per feed. RSS Read then runs once PER INPUT ITEM (built-in behavior of n8n executeOnce=false), so all 3 feeds are fetched in the same workflow run. No SplitInBatches required — removing it avoided the broken `main[0]=done/main[1]=loop` wiring plus the 1→N fan-out batch-advance bug.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO content.items (org_id, source, canonical_url, title, body, hero_image_url, published_at, dedupe_hash, raw_payload, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::jsonb, 'ingested')
ON CONFLICT (org_id, dedupe_hash) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, title, body, source, raw_payload->>'topic' AS topic, canonical_url, hero_image_url;
UPDATE content.items SET status = 'filtered', filter_reason = $2, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1;

UPDATE content.items
SET status = 'enriched',
    enrich_result = $2::jsonb,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1;

nodes.name: Mark enriched
nodes.notes: State-machine: ingested → enriched. Drafting + fan-out is owned by workflow 06 (per-platform) or workflow 08 (batch). This workflow ONLY runs guardrail so the two downstream paths can claim `status='enriched'` with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.

parameters.content:
## State machine (v2.1 — post round-T)

- ingested  → (guardrail reject)   filtered
- ingested  → (guardrail approve)  enriched
- enriched  → (workflow 06 picks)  fanning_out  → drafted
- enriched  → (workflow 08 picks)  batch_rewriting → drafted

Only one of (06, 08) should be enabled at a time for a given org; both use
`FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` plus distinct transitional statuses so they are
safe to co-run, but will duplicate work if both fire.

## Loop pattern

WF01 deliberately does NOT use SplitInBatches. n8n's splitInBatches v3 has
two outputs (done=main[0], loop=main[1]); wiring the loop correctly is
fragile and breaks once a downstream node does a 1→N fan-out (each fan-out
item triggers an extra loop-back, advancing the batch pointer past unread
items). Feeds are iterated natively by RSS Read running once per input,
and article-level context is re-attached via `$('Feed catalogue').item`
paired-item tracking inside the Normalize Code node (runOnceForEachItem).

## On-error

Connect every HTTP Request's `onError: continueErrorOutput` to a shared
notifier, or configure this workflow under Settings → Error Workflow =
`99-error-alert`.
